Name: BFAV Fairy Chicken
Author: judaciously
Description:
Introducing the Fairy Chicken! A tiny, brightly colored chicken with a special, rare drop.

[b]Requirements[/b]: the bfav unofficial update, located over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=posts]here[/url] in the comment thread of the official post.

[b]Features[/b]: two base colors, Blue and Pink! With an optional file for adopt 'n' skin that adds five more colors for each type, giving you twelve options--an entire coop's worth of Fairy Chickens!

Fairy chickens lay valuable eggs that can be turned into even more valuable mayonnaise. Occasionally, they even drop something special... fairy dust.

They require a deluxe coop, and cost 20,000 gold each, a steep price to be sure, but I've hopefully balanced the drops with the steep initial cost. And hey, once you get one, you can hatch more from their eggs!

[b]Credits[/b]: The fairy chicken sprites are edited/referenced from one of the sprites over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7046]here[/url], by Hallowstyx. Be sure to check them out!

To Install, simply unzip and add the folder to your mods folder.

I'm not a coder; I pieced this together with some trial and error. If you have any troubles with it, let me know, and I'll try to help or fix it.

If you'd rather a version that doesn't drop fairy dust, and instead large eggs, I could throw that together, as well.
